AdminAuth.loginDescription: Use an account with server administrator access.
AdminAuth.setupDescription: Create the first administrator account using the setup credential configured on the server. This is only available when the server has no accounts.
AdminAuth.closed: Initial setup is complete or unavailable. Sign in with an administrator account.
AdminAuth.codeRequested: Check your inbox for the sign-in code.
AdminAuth.passwordPolicy: Use 8–64 printable ASCII characters and at least three of: uppercase, lowercase, numbers, symbols.

AdminGrants.signupDescription: Signup links are bound to one email and expire after 7 days.
AdminGrants.resetDescription: Create a reset link valid for 24 hours for an existing account. Resetting the password signs that account out everywhere.
AdminGrants.linkWarning: Copy this link now. You cannot retrieve it again from the list.
AdminGrants.emptyDescription: Create a link for the intended recipient using their email.
AdminGrants.revokeDescription: The recipient will no longer be able to use this link.

Errors.invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect.
Errors.invalidSession: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
Errors.permissionDenied: This account does not have permission for this action.
Errors.notFound: The requested item is not available.
Errors.conflict: Another change prevents this request from completing. Refresh the page to check the current state.
Errors.invalidTransition: This action is not available in the current state.
Errors.invalidProof: This link or setup credential is invalid, expired, already used or revoked.
Errors.emailMismatch: Use the email this link was issued for.
Errors.emailRegistered: This email is already registered. Sign in instead.
Errors.weakPassword: Use a password that meets the displayed requirements.
Errors.invalidCode: The verification code is invalid or expired.
Errors.registrationRequired: A signup link is required before this email can sign in.
Errors.alreadyMember: This user is already a team member.
Errors.alreadyProcessed: This invitation has already been processed.
Errors.ownerTransferRequired: Transfer ownership before leaving the team.
Errors.handleConflict: This team handle is already in use.
Errors.mailUnavailable: Email sign-in is not configured on this server.
Errors.capacityExhausted: Password processing is busy. Try again shortly.
Errors.generic: We could not confirm the result. Refresh the page to check the current state before submitting the change again.
